snippet.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🧩 Wishlist 26 Moves on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4504350/26_Moves_The_Queens_Plot/

Enter a noir mystery world where everyone believes they are the king of their own game. 
Can you solve the mystery before the queen claims the board? 

ABOUT THE GAME:
26 Moves is a narrative-driven Point & Click adventure game.

✨ KEY FEATURES:
• Atmosphere & Art: Hand-crafted noir visuals with cinematic storytelling.
• Mind-bending Puzzles: Solve complex cases through observation and logic.
• Fully Voice Acted: All in-game dialogues feature professional voice talent.
